title: Las Vegas Romantic Self-Guided Jeep Sunset Picnic Adventure
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Travelers will have to put down a deposit for the use of Vehicles and equipment
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Escape the Strip for a private self-guided Jeep picnic adventure into the Spring Mountains, one of the most scenic outdoor areas near Las Vegas. After a route and vehicle walkthrough at our office near the airport, you’ll drive yourself toward Lovell Canyon for mountain views, desert scenery, and a prepared picnic setup made for couples, celebrations, proposals, and travelers looking for something different.

Your experience includes use of a 4x4 vehicle during your adventure window, picnic setup, charcuterie, chilled champagne, snacks, and the freedom to enjoy the mountains at your own pace. This is not a guided tour; we provide the Jeep, route support, gear, and setup instructions so you can enjoy a private off-Strip escape without joining a crowded group experience.

It’s an easy way to experience the quieter side of Las Vegas — scenic roads, open desert, mountain views, and a romantic picnic setting less than an hour from the city.
